source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U21: Identify CTT transaction type,liable party and collection responsibility

payload.title: Read the transaction before choosing a commodity-tax rate
payload.core_explanation_md:
CTT is a transaction tax under the described Finance Act framework. The source distinguishes derivative sales and option events, including exercise and delivery/settlement differences, with agricultural-commodity exclusions. A single rate and payer cannot safely be copied to every commodity event. Identify instrument, event, taxable base, liable side and applicable dated provision.

The recognised exchange collection/remittance role is another obligation; failure to collect is not automatically cancellation of the statutory remittance liability. Do not confuse CTT with income tax on trading profit or with GST on a separate service fee. Current rates need primary verification and are not represented by the old table as a live calculator.

self_check.prompt_text: Does one CTT rate necessarily cover every option sale and exercise event?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The transaction,event,base and liable party differ.

payload.stem_md: An options worksheet uses the same taxpayer and rate for sale and every form of exercise without classifying the event. What is missing?

options.explanation_md: Visual layout does not determine tax.
The source distinguishes these taxable categories.

options.text_md: A rule that all commodities are agricultural
options.explanation_md: The exclusion needs the actual commodity.

options.text_md: The assumption that trading profit equals transaction value
options.explanation_md: Profit and transaction-tax base are distinct.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source distinguishes these taxable categories.

payload.stem_md: An exchange fails to collect a covered CTT amount and records that failure as automatic cancellation of its remittance duty. What does the source require?

options.explanation_md: The statutory duty is not erased by noncollection.

options.text_md: The buyer may privately repeal the tax
options.explanation_md: Private agreement cannot create that exemption.

options.text_md: The amount must become GST instead
options.explanation_md: Distinct taxes do not change identity by default.

options.text_md: Examine the continuing statutory payment obligation despite collection failure
options.explanation_md: Collection and remittance obligations must be tracked separately.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Collection and remittance obligations must be tracked separately.
